role.roleTitle: Quality Analytics Specialist, Automotive Parts Plant

evidence.text: Quality analytics specialist at a body components plant for four years, analysing the plant's inspection and scrap data and running the statistical process control charts for the twenty-two critical characteristics on the two stamping lines.
Prepared the monthly supplier quality report for the plant's two customers under their supplier quality agreements, with the reports accepted by both customers' supplier quality engineers each month.

Investigated capability drops with the line supervisors under the plant's investigation procedure, running the measurement studies with the metrology lab; the corrective actions were approved by the plant quality manager.
Provided the corrective action data to the plant quality manager for each investigation, recording in the investigation file which analyses were mine and which belonged to the supervisors.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation file, filed with the plant quality manager's approval record.
evidence.notes: The candidate wrote the limitation section and hand-over conditions, but the requirement specifies documenting each investigation's limitations and hand-over conditions.
